`make build` replaces this directory with web/dist before compiling the binary.

It is committed so that //go:embed always has an embeddable file to read: with an empty
directory the cmd/server package does not compile, and `make check` would fail on a clean
clone before `make build` ever ran.

The server checks for index.html at startup and serves the API alone when it is absent, so
this placeholder is never mistaken for a web build.
